versions.body:
The board does not change much, and neither do we.

Cod and chips.
Haddock and chips.
The famous harbor chowder.
A bun if you ask for one.
Peas, mushy or otherwise.
Tea, and a slice of something if there is cake.

If it is not on this list, we probably do not have it.

Open daily 11–21.

Kitchen stops a little before closing. If the chowder pot is empty, it is empty.

Salty's Fish Bar has been on Harbor Street since 1971.

We fry fish. We ladle chowder. We did NOT change the oil in 2019, no matter what anyone tells you.

Come in out of the fog.
